Reason: The ultrasound images show multiple variable-sized cystic lesions in the fetal lung (consistent with CCAM type II) and the Doppler image demonstrates an absence of significant blood flow within the lesion, which helps distinguish it from a pulmonary sequestration; such cases are typically managed conservatively during pregnancy unless hydrops develops.
